description_en: Sets the weights of backend servers
description_zh: 调用SetBackendServers设置后端服务器权重
kebab_example: aliyun ens set-backend-servers --load-balancer-id lb-5s7crik3yo3bp03gqrbp50000 --backend-servers Type=ens ServerId=i-5ze0o05xccvbljtn0000 Weight=20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetBackendServers

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Edge Load Balancer (ELB) instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

element_fields.help_en: The ID of the instance that you use as the backend server
element_fields.name: server_id

element_fields.help_en:
The weight of the backend server. Default value: 100. Valid values: **0** to **100**.

> The value 0 indicates that requests are not forwarded to the backend server
element_fields.help_zh:
后端服务器的权重。默认值：100，取值：**0**~**100**。

> 取值为0，表示不会将请求转发给该后端服务器
element_fields.name: weight

element_fields.help_en:
The type of the backend server. Valid values:

- **ens**: ENS instance

- **eni**: elastic network interface (ENI)
element_fields.help_zh:
后端服务器类型。取值：
- **ens**：ENS实例。
- **eni**：弹性网卡实例
element_fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The list of backend servers that you added. You can modify the weights of up to 20 backend servers in each request
parameters.help_zh: 添加的后端服务器列表，每次调用最多可修改20个后端服务器
parameters.name: backend_servers
